title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 missing expiration validation of account tokens allowed a new authenticated…
description: JetBrains Datalore versions prior to 2026.4 contain a vulnerability where account tokens lack expiration validation. This flaw allows an attacker to create a new authenticated session using an expired or otherwise invalid token, potentially leading to unauthorized access. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.4.
